memories.content: The geography department head has prepared the proposal for the coastal field trip, including a risk assessment. They know the new coach operator and that the risk-assessment form needs an extra signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. They want the principal to sign off before the half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters.

Petersfield Secondary School has a half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters for the coastal field trip. The trip has run without incident for four years. This year, there is a new coach operator and the risk-assessment form requires an additional signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The geography department head can submit the proposal to the principal for approval.
